claim: Multi-office branded dental groups retained as if independent: Tender Smiles 4 Kids (1330 How Ln), Garden State Smiles (1612 NJ-27), Brighter Dental (960 Shoppes Blvd)
problem: All three are single-brand regional chains. Tender Smiles 4 Kids lists six NJ offices (Freehold, North Brunswick, Edison, Linden, Ocean, Old Bridge) on tendersmiles4kids.com; Garden State Smiles lists five (North Brunswick, Hamilton, Matawan, Brick, Toms River); Brighter Dental lists five (Delran, Freehold, North Brunswick, Princeton, Robbinsville). The mapper's own exclusion list removed Great Clips, Hand & Stone, Twin Boro PT and JAG PT for exactly this reason, so retaining these three is inconsistent with the stated rules. The entries themselves are accurate; only their eligibility is wrong.
fix: Drop Tender Smiles 4 Kids, Garden State Smiles and Brighter Dental, or apply one explicit rule ('branded group with 3+ offices = chain, excluded') across the whole list and re-run the exclusions.

claim: Two Advocare practices retained: Advocare North Brunswick Medical Associates (986 Shoppes Blvd) and Advocare North Brunswick Pediatrics (1950 NJ-27)
problem: Both are offices of Advocare, which states it has more than 900 physicians/providers across NJ, PA and DE (advocaredoctors.com), i.e. a large network, not a local independent practice. The mapper flagged this in notes but included them anyway. Both entries are factually correct.
fix: Decide whether network-affiliated primary-care offices are in scope. If not, remove both; if yes, say so in the zone rules so other zones treat Advocare/Summit/Vanguard offices the same way.

claim: New Horizons Physical Therapy & Lymphedema Care - address '20 Towne Center Dr'
problem: The practice's own contact page gives 620 Towne Center Dr, North Brunswick, NJ 08902 (phone 732-658-1896 matches). '20 Towne Center Dr' appears to be a typo and is a different, non-existent street number.
fix: Change address to 620 Towne Center Dr.

claim: Entry named 'MARTIAL ARTS DOJANG' at 990 Shoppes Blvd, (732) 944-0183
problem: The business is real and at that address, but 'MARTIAL ARTS DOJANG' is a map-listing artifact; the operator brands itself Martial Arts Academy of NJ (MAANJ), maanj.com. Same problem as 'Fresh style barbersho1 Only Page' for Fresh Style Barbershop (2244 US-130) - the mapper noted that one but not this one.
fix: Rename to 'Martial Arts Academy of NJ (MAANJ)' and add website https://maanj.com/.

claim: Caveat: 'Barbers: only two independent barbershops surfaced'
problem: Four more independent barbershops are listed on the same directory the mapper used for other categories (bestprosintown.com/nj/north-brunswick/barbers/): North Side Haircutters (662 Georges Rd), VIP Barber Shop (676 Georges Rd), Fusion Barber Studio (1825 US-130) and EVIECUTS (Hermann Road). The stated thinness of this category is not supported.
fix: Add the three with full addresses and correct the 'categories_thin' note for barbers.

claim: Nail salons: 5 entries listed, caveat implies the category is covered
problem: Only 2 of 6 independent nail salons found are on the list. Missing: Nail Fever & Spa (1825 US-130), Nail Studio 2 (512 Georges Rd), Splendor Nails (676 Georges Rd), Evey's Beauty & Spa (1610 US-130). No caveat mentions nails as thin.
fix: Add the four missing salons and add nails to categories_thin or explain the omission.

claim: Missing dentists: Always Smile Dental Care (2000 NJ-27), AmeriDental (1553 Ruth Rd #3), Dental Cosmetic Center of North Brunswick, Dr. Meetu Soni (746 Livingston Ave Ste 2)
problem: All four are ranked in the same 24-clinic North Brunswick Township dentist ranking that the mapper relied on for other entrants, and none is in businesses.json. Always Smile Dental Care is the #4 ranked clinic in town (4.9 stars, 167 reviews) - a notable omission for a dentist-heavy zone.
fix: Add these four dentist entries with addresses and phones before outreach.

claim: Sources: most entries cite only a Bing Maps query URL (e.g. https://www.bing.com/maps?q=dentist+north+brunswick+nj)
problem: A Bing Maps search URL is not a stable per-business citation - it returns a different result set on each run and cannot be re-checked. About 60 of ~85 entries rely on it alone. This is a source-quality problem, not a factual error: I was able to re-verify nearly all of them through other pages.
fix: For future zones, cite the individual listing page, the practice's own site, or a stable directory profile per business.

claim: Duplicate-person risk: 'Brunswick Chiropractic Center of New Jersey' (908-753-5454) and 'Dr. Neil Kosin, Chiropractor' (732-409-7774), both 1594 US-130
problem: Neil I. Kosin, DC is listed as the chiropractor at Brunswick Chiropractic Center at that address, and both phone numbers appear on the practice's own site/listings. These are probably one office counted twice, which would inflate the list and cause two cold approaches to one practice.
fix: Merge into one entry ('Brunswick Chiropractic Center of New Jersey - Neil Kosin, DC') or confirm they are separate practices in the building.

claim: Duplicate-person risk: 'Robin Deiner, Counselor' and 'Helene Steinhauer, Counselor', both 343 Old Georges Rd Suite 201 with the identical phone (848) 893-1932
problem: Identical address and phone on two separate entries suggests a shared front-desk number for a group practice rather than two independently reachable clinicians. The number cannot belong to both individually.
fix: Verify each clinician has a direct contact before listing both; otherwise keep one entry for the group practice.
